findings.finding: The two model-family axes are a descriptive taxonomy rather than two empirically independent selections: only the E-axis has a proposed discriminator, while the Gamma-shape axis has no Gamma-to-observable forward map or discriminator.

findings.finding: Freezing siren parameters would not make dL^GW/dL^EM uniquely EFC-discriminating: the invariant F(phi_0)/F(phi(z)) history must be fixed under a declared field normalization and compared with GR systematics and rival friction models.
findings.test: Freeze the invariant F(z)/F(0) trajectory and compare the same siren likelihood against GR with systematics and at least one generic running-Planck-mass/scalar-tensor friction model.
findings.reasoning: F-para-4, F-alt-5/F-alt-6, F-form-6/F-form-7, and F-mp-4 converge that a non-unit ratio is a class-level propagation observable and that separate alpha/phi coordinates are not themselves invariant without normalization.
